description:
[narrowed from route-edit-d225cebc] investigate and decompose gap reach-history-weekly-counter-inflated-beyond-total-executions-ever: in repos/activity-api/src/services/trace-retention.ts, the rollupReachHistory function folds reach counts into reach_history with an additive UPSERT. The exact lines are:

           reached = (reached ?? 0) + $reached,
           total = (total ?? 0) + $total,

Because the bucket UPSERT is additive and the watermark UPSERT is a separate statement issued afterwards, any run whose bucket writes suc
